counterfactual_missing_items: hypermobility of shoulders, digits, and knees
decisive_items: lens dislocation superonasally in the right eye
response.rationale: R1 directly supports the core ocular findings (IOP and lens dislocation) with no raw contradictions, whereas R4, despite supporting tall stature and long fingers, is contradicted by normal serial echocardiograms and negative family history. R2 is weakened by open angle and lack of systemic features; R3 has no raw support.

rejected.why: Raw contradictions include open iridocorneal angle and absence of Haab striae; lacks tall stature and hypermobility.
No raw support spans; only non-specific hypermobility, which is insufficient.
Contradicted by normal echocardiograms and negative family history, which are key for Marfan syndrome.
